assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. A joyful medieval ship-crew group portrait aboard the war cog Der Seebär, a celebration inside the wooden crew quarters. EXACTLY SIX adult men, each reference appears exactly once, retain individually distinguishable facial identities, hair colors, hair lengths, distinctive hairstyles and clothing heraldry. All are adults 18 to 23. Their faces must be visible and large enough to recognize. Anatomically plausible bodies, hands firmly holding tankard handles, no floating objects.
REFERENCE MAP: Image 1 is a labelled six-person contact sheet for identification only, do not reproduce its grid or labels. Top row from left: Rhydian, Ianto, Gwylim. Bottom row from left: Llew, Unig, Padrig. Images 2,3,4 provide additional full-size detail for Rhydian, Ianto and Gwylim respectively. All six subjects must appear in the NEW scene. Character descriptions:
1 RHYDIAN ARTH,22,the captain: long loose straight copper-red hair past shoulders, small red chin beard, natural pale green eyes, dark plate armor with golden trim, white fur collar, red bear emblem. Warm confident centerpiece.
2 IANTO PAWEN,23,first mate: high red ponytail, athletic face, russet brown fur collar and black/red armor with red bear face motif. Boisterous laughter.
3 GWYLIM ARTH,21,second mate: vivid red high ponytail, youthful clean-shaven face, white fur on black/red armor, red bear crest. Mischievous grin.
4 LLEW DYFRGI,18: SHORT orange-red tousled hair, natural blue eyes, youthful clean-shaven face, navy blue tabard with warm orange trim, dark armor and tan fur. Laughing with delight.
5 UNIG UNIGOL,22: long loose dark copper-red hair, small sharp dark-red goatee, dark armor with rust fur collar and very restrained heraldry, cocky crooked smile.
6 PADRIG EIRTH,18: straight chin-length deep red hair, pale blue/gray eyes, youthful clean-shaven face, silver plate armor and ivory fur cloak. Usually reserved, now a small amused smile.
Do not blend their traits. Do NOT copy the tense combat poses or weapons from references. All weapons put away and outside frame. They drink ale from simple medieval wooden tankards and celebrate a successful evening, genuine friendly camaraderie, strong varied expressive faces. Minimal props: a small number of solid wooden tankards, one sturdy table and one warm hanging lantern; plain wooden walls and beams behind them, NO background people, no excessive bottles or dishes, no confetti, no writing, no watermark. Organized vertical composition in two levels, close friendly grouping; never an overcrowded crowd.
VERBINDLICHER STIL: Bildformat 2:3, 1024 × 1536. Strenger Frieren/One Piece Anime Art Style. Markante, überzeichnete Gesichtszüge und Proportionen, starke Mimik, klare Anime-Lineart und sauberes Cel-Shading. Weiche, simple Anime-Texturen für Haut, Stoff, Holz, Stein und Hintergrund. Keine realistischen Texturen, kein Fotorealismus, keine malerische Darstellung. Weniger ist mehr, was Hintergrund anbelangt. Saturated clean anime colors, warm lantern light rendered as simple cel-shaded shapes, no realistic materials.

Preserve EXACTLY the boy's youthful face and age14, cheeky grin, dark brown ponytail and little braid, blue-gray eyes, blue/white tunic, modest silver armor, tan fur collar, seabird badge, slim adolescent build. DO NOT make him older or adult.
CHANGE THE COMPOSITION TO A CLOSE UPPER-BODY PORTRAIT: head including ponytail to hips/belt only. Camera close; face large and prominent, shoulders and torso fill the canvas. He is standing but legs and boots are OUTSIDE the frame. Not a full-body portrait. Keep 2:3 vertical frame.
REPLACE the malformed original axe completely. Give him a clearly constructed compact DOUBLE-BLADED BATTLE AXE like the sister's reference: TWO opposed curved steel blades extending LEFT and RIGHT from one sturdy central metal socket, the whole axe head mounted TRANSVERSELY across a straight wooden haft at a right angle. NOT a spear point, not a dagger along the shaft, not a halberd. The shaft visibly enters the central socket between the two blades; correct mechanical construction. Blade faces visible broadside. Axe head at shoulder height beside his body, fully inside the image and safely away from face. His right gloved hand grips the straight wooden shaft BELOW its head at mid-chest height, fingers and thumb visibly wrapped around the handle in a physically plausible grip. Lower shaft continues down toward lower frame. Left hand rests at his belt. No other weapon. No violence or injury.
Simple ship rail, blue sky and sea background, no additional figures or props. No text, no watermark.
